# Function instructions

The `.function` stack holds functions: a body with typed holes. An instruction that starves for arguments is shelved here, bare, and `.codePushAllFunctions` converts a code block into the functions its pushes compute. Map, filter, reduce and their relatives on the collection pages take the topmost function here that fits their job.

## Operations

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.functionApply` | Applies the topmost function on `.function` with an output to the program's values, taking a filler for each hole from its stack as the instruction itself would (`a b` and a bare `.intSubtract` give a − b), and pushes its result; refuses when it leaves none. | the topmost fitting `function`, n × `bool`, n × `int`, n × `double`, n × `code`, n × `char`, n × `string`, n × `vecBool`, n × `vecInt`, n × `vecDouble`, n × `vecString`, n × `iterator`, n × `binding`, n × `function` | `bool` or `int` or `double` or `code` or `char` or `string` or `vecBool` or `vecInt` or `vecDouble` or `vecString` or `iterator` or `binding` or `function`; may refuse |
| `.functionArity` | Counts the holes of the top function, leaving it. | `function` (read) | `int` |
| `.functionCompose` | Composes: `f g .functionCompose`, g the topmost function with an output and f the next with a hole of that type, gives f after g, g's program in f's first such hole; refuses a result over the size limit, before building it. | the topmost fitting `function`, the topmost fitting `function` | `function`; may refuse |
| `.functionEq` | Pushes whether the top two functions are equal, leaving both. | `function` (read), `function` (read) | `bool` |
| `.functionFill` | Partial application: the topmost function with a hole takes the top item of its first hole's stack, which fills that hole wherever it occurs, leaving a function with one hole fewer; refuses a result over the size limit, before building it. | the topmost fitting `function`, n × `bool`, n × `int`, n × `double`, n × `code`, n × `char`, n × `string`, n × `vecBool`, n × `vecInt`, n × `vecDouble`, n × `vecString`, n × `iterator`, n × `binding`, n × `function` | `function`; may refuse |
| `.functionIterate` | Iterates: `x n .functionIterate` applies the topmost step function on `.function` (a hole of its own output's type) n times from x; its other holes are read from the run; refuses a negative n, or when filler runs short or steps run out. | the topmost fitting `function`, `int`, n × `bool`, n × `int`, n × `double`, n × `code`, n × `char`, n × `string`, n × `vecBool`, n × `vecInt`, n × `vecDouble`, n × `vecString`, n × `iterator`, n × `binding`, n × `function` | `bool` or `int` or `double` or `code` or `char` or `string` or `vecBool` or `vecInt` or `vecDouble` or `vecString` or `iterator` or `binding` or `function`; may refuse |
| `.functionIterateUntil` | The orbit: `x p f .functionIterateUntil`, f the topmost step function on `.function` and p the topmost predicate on its type below it, gives x, f(x), f(f(x)), … up to and including the first value p holds for, as a vector (a string of chars); refuses an orbit over the size limit or one that cannot be collected, or when filler runs short or steps run out. | the topmost fitting `function`, the topmost fitting `function`, n × `bool`, n × `int`, n × `double`, n × `code`, n × `char`, n × `string`, n × `vecBool`, n × `vecInt`, n × `vecDouble`, n × `vecString`, n × `iterator`, n × `binding`, n × `function` | `vecBool` or `vecDouble` or `vecInt` or `vecString` or `string`; may refuse |
| `.functionRefAs` | Binds the top function to key k from `.int`, taking both and shadowing any older binding of k: `x k .functionRefAs`. | `function`, `int` | `binding` |

## Reading the environment

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.functionRef` | Binds a copy of the top function, left in place, to a fresh key and pushes the key onto `.int`. | `function` (read) | `binding`, `int` |

## Control

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.functionDo` | Runs the top function's body as code, once: `f .functionDo` is `f .codeFromFunction .codeDo`. | `function` | the rest of the program |
| `.functionDoCount` | Counts with the top function's body as code: `n f .functionDoCount` is `n f .codeFromFunction .execDoCount`, pushing 0 to n − 1 before each pass. | `int`, `function` | the rest of the program |
| `.functionDoRange` | Steps an index with the top function's body as code: `a b f .functionDoRange` is `a b f .codeFromFunction .execDoRange`. | `int`, `int`, `function` | the rest of the program |
| `.functionDoTimes` | Repeats the top function's body as code: `n f .functionDoTimes` is `n f .codeFromFunction .execDoTimes`; the body then returns to `.code` as a code block. | `int`, `function` | the rest of the program |
| `.functionIf` | Runs one of two functions' bodies as code: `p then else .functionIf` is `p then .codeFromFunction else .codeFromFunction .execIf`. | `bool`, `function`, `function` | the rest of the program |
| `.functionWhile` | Loops with the top function's body as code while the top bool is true: `p f .functionWhile` is `p f .codeFromFunction .execWhile`. | `bool`, `function` | the rest of the program |
| `.functionWith` | Binds a copy of the top function to a fresh key, runs a body code block from `.code` with the key on `.int`, then removes the binding. | `code`, `function` (read) | the rest of the program |

## Output

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.functionPrint` | Moves the top function to `.print`. | `function` | `print` |

## The stack's own instructions

Every stack has the same family for copying, deleting, reordering and measuring its items; see <doc:StackInstructions>. On `.function` they are `.functionDeepDup`, `.functionDeleteAtDepth`, `.functionDup`, `.functionDupItems`, `.functionDupTimes`, `.functionFlush`, `.functionPop`, `.functionPopItems`, `.functionRot`, `.functionShove`, `.functionStackDepth`, `.functionStackIsEmpty`, `.functionSwap`, `.functionYank`, `.functionYankDup`.
